title: Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and spicy stew originating from Tunisia, made with tender lamb and a blend of aromatic spices. Serve over couscous or rice for a hearty meal.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb and set aside.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, turmeric, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return the lamb to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2-1/2 to 3 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve over couscous or rice, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
